text:
eli: FYI ran the nightly access-scan and found ~47 admin roles with no owners across prod and staging. creating thread for quick triage + routing to quarterly review.

nina: ow — was this the script change from last week? which teams are most affected?

eli: script is same. this surfaced after the identity sync hiccup on 03/10 where some owner attributes dropped. top hit is svc-analytics-runner@proj-ops, infra:billing-admin@proj-fin, and a couple of cross-project bot principals. short list: svc-analytics-runner, infra:billing-admin, svc-data-sync, svc-ml-train.

sam: can you paste the scan output? a small sample is fine.

eli: ```
2026-03-22 05:02 accessscan: principal=svc-analytics-runner@proj-ops roles=[admin:read, admin:write] owners=[] last_owner_change=2025-11-02
2026-03-22 05:02 accessscan: principal=infra:billing-admin@proj-fin roles=[billing:admin] owners=[] last_owner_change=2024-01-15
2026-03-22 05:02 accessscan: principal=svc-ml-train@proj-model roles=[admin:exec] owners=[] last_owner_change=2025-06-10
```

audits-bot: NOTE: ownerless principals are high-risk for admin-entitlement sweeps. recommend immediate owner proof requirement and temp-disable promotion flows.

raj: agree with bot. let's do a tiered response: 1) short-term: put these principals into read-only by policy lock for 24h except for emergency breaks with manager approval 2) mid-term: run ownerproof emails to last known owners and team leads 3) long-term: add owner attr to identity-sync SLA and fail-fast on missing owner metadata.

marie: compliance-bot — any regulatory flags for billing-admin temporary demotion?

compliance-bot: POLICY_CHECK: demoting billing-admin affects invoice generation pipelines. require an exceptions ticket and a 24h runbook to manually verify billing outputs if demotion proceeds.

nina: maybe we shouldn't mass demote billing-admin until a safe window. can we isolate by project and add extra audit hooks instead?

eli: fine. I'll lock svc-analytics-runner and svc-ml-train immediately (they're infra-adjacent). leaving infra:billing-admin for manual whitelisting. running ownerproof emails now: sending to last_known_owner_emails.txt.

sam: thanks. also add these principals to the next least-privilege audit batch and mark as high-priority for the quarterly access review.

eli: ownerproof emails dispatched. sample justification flow: ```
Subject: Action required: Confirm ownership for principal=svc-analytics-runner@proj-ops
Body: We detected missing owner metadata. Reply with approved owner email or request a handback ticket within 7 days or principal will be queued for entitlement pruning.```

raj: let's also instrument the audit log to tag any ownerless-admin actions and spike alerts. if ownerless principal does admin attachments > 2 in 1h raise a pager.

marie: creating follow-up card in security board: card-4902 "Ownerless admin cleanups + identity-sync hardening" and assigning to eli/raj/sam. will include compliance exception path for billing.

nina: one more ask — can we include a short blurb in next week's all-hands about why owner metadata matters? keeps product teams honest.

eli: good idea. I'll draft a 3-line explainer and link to the ownerproof playbook.

sam: closing for now - we'll reconvene after ownerproof results. thanks team. :white_check_mark:
